in_hindi.name: महसाना

in_english.long_meaning: The name Mahsana is derived from the Arabic root "m-h-s", which means "to benefit" or "to do good". In Islamic tradition, the name Mahsana is associated with the qualities of a virtuous woman who brings happiness and prosperity to her family.
